svg.title: Basic export benchmark: all four sizes

cc:Work.dc:title: Basic export benchmark: all four sizes
cc:Work.dc:description: Linear axis. Circles: Rust; squares: genanki. Points are medians of 10 fresh-process exports; whiskers show IQR spread, not confidence. Full numeric table is in report.md.
